expectations.text: Rejects the equal 20% weight distribution outright rather than tuning the numbers inside it
expectations.evidence: "Equal weights, no justification. Nobody decided this ranking; the spreadsheet format did." The entire criteria set is replaced, not re-tuned.

expectations.text: States that every weight must carry a written one-line justification
expectations.evidence: "Weights: individually justified, not equal, not best-worst" and the corrected scorecard table has a 'Justification' column for each weight.

expectations.text: Names resource complementarity and organizational compatibility as the two criteria that should carry the highest weight
expectations.evidence: Table lists 'Resource complementarity | 25%' and 'Organizational compatibility | 20%' as the top two weights.

expectations.text: Points out that neither complementarity nor compatibility appears anywhere in the user's five existing criteria
expectations.evidence: The memo critiques Brand, Market size, Account overlap, Exec relationship, Revenue potential individually but never explicitly states that complementarity/compatibility were absent from that original five.

expectations.text: Flags brand strength and exec relationship, together 40% of the sheet, as logo halo and relationship criteria that crowd out fit
expectations.evidence: "Brand + exec relationship = 40% of the score. Logo halo and a personal CEO relationship are the two documented ways this exercise fools itself."

expectations.text: Caps account overlap as one input rather than leaving it as an equal share of the ranking spine
expectations.evidence: "Verified account overlap | 10%, capped | Flags warm accounts, doesn't predict success on its own; capped deliberately"

expectations.text: Introduces an effort column and ranks candidates on value divided by effort
expectations.evidence: Ranked table includes 'Effort (mgr-months)' and 'Value ÷ effort' columns driving the 'Rank' column.

expectations.text: States the ranking order explicitly as value divided by effort, then value composite, then logo attractiveness
expectations.evidence: No such tie-break sequence (value÷effort, then composite, then logo attractiveness) is stated anywhere; brand/logo is dropped as a criterion entirely.

expectations.text: Shows that Northwind Cloud's 7 manager-months move its position once effort divides value, rather than leaving it first
expectations.evidence: "Once effort is divided in, the order the halo scorecard produced (Northwind > Piedmont > Solvexa) inverts almost completely... the hyperscaler looks best raw and worst per manager-month."

expectations.text: Draws the capacity line on summed effort estimates rather than on the headcount number of three
expectations.evidence: "Capacity line: effort-sum, cross-checked against your headcount statement" and "Effort-sum against 2 managers: Solvexa (4) + Piedmont (6) + a staged, capped Northwind phase-one... = roughly 13 manager-months"

expectations.text: Runs a sensitivity check shifting each weight plus or minus 20% and reports which positions hold and which flip
expectations.evidence: The Sensitivity section is explicitly qualitative and defers the numeric test: "run the numeric ±20% pass once real scores exist" — it was not actually run.

expectations.text: Applies a tie band of roughly 5% and refuses to treat a sub-5% composite gap as decisive
expectations.evidence: Only a vague 'tie-band call' is mentioned ("0.63 vs 0.51 is a real gap, not a tie") with no explicit ~5% threshold stated anywhere in this section.

expectations.text: Scores the CEO-connected Northwind Cloud on the same sheet as every other candidate rather than protecting or excluding it
expectations.evidence: Northwind Cloud is scored in the same 'Ranked table' alongside Solvexa and Piedmont on identical columns.

expectations.text: Ends with at least one candidate not making the shortlist, each non-shortlisted candidate carrying an explicit verdict
expectations.evidence: "Below the line: the six unnamed candidates — hold, pending scoring on the corrected criteria. Re-entry trigger: scorecard complete for each."
